d: In this episode of Rajdoot, Hosted by Nikhil, Written by Sajid, we look at the dramatic fallout between Michigan Democrats Abdul El-Sayed and Haley Stevens, whose bitter rivalry has erupted just days before the US midterm elections. After losing the Democratic Senate primary to El-Sayed, Stevens unexpectedly endorsed his Republican rival Mike Rogers, exposing deep divisions within the Democratic Party. We explore how disagreements over Israel, campaign politics and personal tensions turned a post-primary unity effort into an extraordinary political showdown, why Stevens decided to break…
